headline: Electricity Price Reasonable, but Not All Risks and Costs Passed on to Users
summary: A Vietnamese member of parliament said not every actual project cost should be treated as reasonable. He proposed a transparent framework that lets investors recover legitimate costs while informing consumers.
why: Electricity pricing rules determine whether power investors can recover costs, which shapes returns and investment appetite in the power sector.
